decisions.reason: As a first-year launch tightly aligned with the firm's automation strategy and core plant offer, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot still has substantial upside uncertainty and is worth keeping as a relatively close-to-core option.

The automatic de-shuttering robot should be kept because after only one year the firm has not learned enough to abandon it, and a specialized module can fit customers who do not yet want the full combined solution.

The profile storage robot complements automated precast workflows and, given the firm's broad range and system-integration strengths, is a low-regret option to keep while market acceptance becomes clearer.

The automatic shuttering robot remains worth keeping because it extends the established product family, supports tailored plant configurations, and there is no evidence yet that its value has been disproved.
